prompt:
You describe a graph or chart from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What is plotted against what: for each axis, the quantity, the unit and the range (first and last tick labels).
2. Each curve or series: its label or condition (temperature, voltage, mode, ...) and its overall trend in words.
3. Values printed in the figure as text (annotations, labelled points, legend values). Do not estimate values from where a curve sits; if a value is not printed, describe the trend in words instead.

Figure type: graph or chart
Section: 1.5 Transmitter RF Path > 1.5.1 Low Frequency Power Amplifier (LF PA) (LR20xx) > LR2021/LR2022/LR2012
Caption: Figure 1-6: LF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (490 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO)
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): x: Targeted Power (dBm), 10 to 20 | y: TX Power (dBm), 10 to 20 | y2: IDDTX (mA), 10 to 80
Text that mentions the figure: The Tx Power (orange curve) demonstrates good linearity from 10 dBm to 22 dBm target power, with the actual output power closely tracking the targeted power. Current consumption (blue curve) shows a non-linear relationship range, as the current increases progressively at higher power levels, from approximately 18 mA at +10 dBm to 120 mA at +22 dBm.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Graph of LF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (490 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO).

The x-axis is Targeted Power (dBm), ranging from 10 to 20.
The left y-axis is TX Power (dBm), ranging from 10 to 20.
The right y-axis is IDDTX (mA), ranging from 10 to 80.

There are two curves:
- TX Power (orange curve): This curve shows an overall increasing trend.
- IDDTX (blue curve): This curve shows an overall increasing trend.

Text inside the figure includes:
x: Targeted Power (dBm), 10 to 20
y: TX Power (dBm), 10 to 20
y2: IDDTX (mA), 10 to 80
The legend shows "TX Power (dBm)" and "IDDTX (mA)".
